'''2018 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship, 5–7 January 2018. [[Reid Smith]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-match-play-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' United States
* '''Dates:''' 5–7 January 2018
* '''Winner:''' [[Reid Smith]]
